summary_1line: Arjuna departs with Krishna to slay Jayadratha amid auspicious omens while assigning Satyaki to guard Yudhishthira; Dhritarashtra laments the looming disaster after Abhimanyu’s death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna drives Arjuna’s radiant chariot with the ape-banner while auspicious winds blow and musicians play as they ride toward Jayadratha.
Arjuna, bow in hand on the chariot, turns to Satyaki and entrusts him with protecting Yudhishthira before racing into battle.
In a darkened palace, the blind king Dhritarashtra mournfully speaks to Sanjaya as the once‑joyful Kaurava camp falls silent.
